# Skill: run-hurl-api-tests

**When to use:** Verify a Conduit REST backend against the canonical Hurl suite in realworld/specs/api/hurl.

## Scope
- `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh`
- `realworld/specs/api/hurl`
- `realworld/specs/api/openapi.yml`

## Prerequisites
- hurl CLI installed on the operator machine
- HTTP backend reachable at HOST (default localhost:8000 per analysis)

## Steps
1. Set HOST (and UID_VAL if required) for isolated test data.
2. Run realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh with no arguments to execute all realworld/specs/api/hurl/*.hurl, or pass specific .hurl file paths.
3. Alternatively use realworld/specs/api/hurl/run-hurl-tests.sh with hurl --test and variables host and uid.

- `Analysis entry point realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh; OpenAPI contract realworld/specs/api/openapi.yml.`
